description: List all vehicle models for a given make and year. Returns slugs used as the "model" input for list-generations, list-modifications, and search-by-model.

make.description: Manufacturer slug (e.g., "audi", "ford"). Get slugs from list-makes.

year.description: 4-digit model year 1900-2100 (e.g., 2020). Get valid years from list-years.

name: list-models
